description: Source code for internal utility functions and classes related to source code analysis and manipulation within the PyTorch project, including source extraction, normalization, and parsing of function definitions.

classes.name: SourceContext
classes.description: A wrapper class extending SourceRangeFactory to store metadata about source code segments, including filename, line number, and usage of true division.

methods.name: get_source_lines_and_file
methods.description: Retrieves source lines, line number, and filename for a given object, handling errors if source is unavailable.

methods.name: normalize_source_lines
methods.description: Adjusts indentation of source lines to align function definitions and bodies properly.

methods.name: make_source_context
methods.description: Creates and caches a SourceContext object with source code metadata.

methods.name: parse_def
methods.description: Parses a function object into an AST, normalizes source, and creates a ParsedDef with source metadata.
